definitions: Denoting or relating to a type of retail or online commerce that aims to provide customers with a seamless shopping experience whether they're shopping online from a desktop or mobile device, by telephone, or in a brick-and-mortar store.
Involving or combining all available channels of communication and sales to provide a unified customer experience.
examples: The company implemented an omnichannel strategy.
They are known for their omnichannel approach to customer service.
The new platform supports an omnichannel retail experience.
